chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sinani (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariya al-Qattan narrated that Abu Muhammad Bakr ibn Ubaydillah ibn Habib narrated that Tamim ibn Bohlool narrated from his father from Isma'il ibn Mehran from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said:
When any one of you performs Hajj, let him conclude his Hajj with our visitation, for that is from the completion of the Hajj.
ai.seo_question: What completes the Hajj pilgrimage according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) instructs that concluding one's Hajj with a visit to the Imams perfects the pilgrimage, elevating it from a mere ritual to a comprehensive act of devotion. This underscores the Shia scholarly view that the Ahl al-Bayt serve as the spiritual guides and living proof of God's covenant, making their visitation an essential component of completing the religious duty. The emphasis on 'visiting us' reflects the unique status of the Imams as the inheritors of prophetic knowledge and divine authority.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 66-28 Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sinani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariya al-Qattan quoted Abu Muhammad Bakr ibn Ubaydillah ibn Habib, on the authority of Tamim ibn Bohlool, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Isma’il ibn Mehran, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as-Sadiq) (a.s.),

“Whenever any of you finish your Hajj pilgrimage to the Kaaba, come to (Khorasan to) complete your Hajj pilgrimage by visiting us (i.e. Ar-Ridha’’s (a.s.) shrine). This indeed will complete the Hajj.”
